Dear Shareholders, FY2025-26 was a year of execution, transition and laying the foundation for the Company's next phase of growth.
India's addressable eyewear market was estimated at approximately ₹75,000 crore in FY2025, highlighting the strong structural opportunity for the industry.
Growth & demand: Revenue from Operations grew by 24.95% to ₹53.99 crore, while EBITDA increased by 17.04% to ₹14.73 crore, with an EBITDA margin of 27.28%.
The Indian optical industry continues to benefit from rising eye -care awareness, increasing demand for premium products and the growth of organised optical retail.

We remain confident of maintaining our growth momentum and aspire to significantly expand ou r market share through innovation, operational excellence, customer-centricity and deeper market penetration.
